name: China State Construction Engineering Corporation Limited
summary: China State Construction Engineering Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an investment and construction company in China and internationally. It operates through five segments: Housing Construction Projects; Infrastructure Construction and Investment; Real Estate Development and Investment; Design and Investigation; and Others.
